text: In accordance with Section B.3. of the Terms of Reference of the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee, the Committee will elect a member of the public as Vice-Chair.

The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee: 1. Elected Christine Michaud as Vice-Chair of the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee for a term of office starting on December 7, 2023 and ending November 14, 2026, and until a successor is appointed.
